definitions.explanation: A grand, far-reaching goal for one's life — bigger than ordinary career or personal goals. A formal, somewhat literary word, famous from William S. Clark's saying {少年|しょうねん}よ、{大志|たいし}を{抱|いだ}け ("Boys, be ambitious").

examples.japanese: {大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
{若|わか}いうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to have great ambitions while young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いて→抱く：02010_idaku⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れ→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧、⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Holding lofty ambitions, he left his hometown and headed for the city.

notes:
Compound of {大|たい} (great) + {志|し} (will, intention). A formal noun, often paired with ⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (to hold, to harbor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor great ambitions
- {大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have great ambitions
- ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧、{大志|たいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}け→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: "Boys, be ambitious" (famous Clark quote)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{志|こころざし}→志：06655_kokorozashi⟧: aspiration; will — broader, also formal
- ⟦{野望|やぼう}→野望：05528_yabou⟧: ambition — often with a negative ring of selfish or excessive desire
- ⟦{野心|やしん}→野心：15757_yashin⟧: ambition; aspiration — can be neutral or negative depending on context
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: dream — everyday word, less formal
